<!-- Generated by tools/docgen from doc comments. Do not edit: run scripts/docs.sh. -->

```odin
import surface "fire:surface"
```

Control surfaces: scripts, loaded from dynamic libraries, that connect a
hardware controller to the app.

A script library exports `fire_surface_entry`, which lists its surfaces
(`Descriptor`): one per controller model, with hints for finding its MIDI
ports. A surface instance receives the controller's MIDI and the app's
changes (controls moving, the transport), and acts through its `Host`:
it sends MIDI back (LEDs, displays, motorized faders), drives the
transport, moves the controls the app publishes, and sets parameters of
graph nodes the app names. Everything runs on the app's control thread,
from `manager_update`.

Scripts can be written in Odin (import this package for the types) or in
C (`fire_surface.h` in this folder declares the same ABI).

```odin
m, _ := surface.manager_create({clock = clock, timeline = song, graph = g,
	midi_out = send_to_controller, on_set = apply_control})
lib, _ := surface.library_open(m, "scripts/mini.dylib")
s, _ := surface.surface_start(m, lib, 0, {})
surface.control_publish(m, {id = 1, name = "Volume", kind = .Continuous, max = 1}, 0.8)
// every UI frame:
surface.manager_update(m)
```

See /guides/surfaces/.

## Constants

### ABI_VERSION

```odin
ABI_VERSION :: 1
```

The script ABI's version: a script with another version is refused.

### ENTRY_SYMBOL

```odin
ENTRY_SYMBOL :: "fire_surface_entry"
```

The symbol a script library exports: a `Entry_Proc`.

## Types

### Entry_Proc

```odin
Entry_Proc :: proc "cdecl"(index: u32) -> ^Descriptor
```

What a script library exports: its surfaces by index, nil past the last.

### Descriptor

```odin
Descriptor :: struct {
	abi_version: u32,
	id: cstring,
	name: cstring,
	vendor: cstring,
	input_hints: [^]cstring,
	output_hints: [^]cstring,
	create: proc "cdecl"(host: ^Host) -> ^Surface,
}
```

One kind of surface a script library provides.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `abi_version` |  |
| `id` | reverse-domain, stable: "com.example.mini" |
| `name` | "Example Mini" |
| `vendor` |  |
| `input_hints` | nil-terminated: substrings of the controller's MIDI input port names |
| `output_hints` | likewise for its output ports |
| `create` | nil on failure |

### Surface

```odin
Surface :: struct {
	data: rawptr,
	destroy: proc "cdecl"(s: ^Surface),
	on_midi: proc "cdecl"(s: ^Surface, port: u32, bytes: [^]u8, size: u32),
	on_control: proc "cdecl"(s: ^Surface, id: u32, value: f64),
	on_controls_changed: proc "cdecl"(s: ^Surface),
	on_transport: proc "cdecl"(s: ^Surface, state: ^Transport_State),
	on_idle: proc "cdecl"(s: ^Surface),
}
```

A running surface, as its script made it. The host calls these on the
control thread; any may be nil.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `data` | the script's own |
| `destroy` |  |
| `on_midi` | a short message or a whole SysEx |
| `on_control` | the app moved a control |
| `on_controls_changed` | controls were published or removed: read them again |
| `on_transport` | playing, tempo, loop or bar changed |
| `on_idle` | every `manager_update`: meters, blinking, timeouts |

### Transport_State

```odin
Transport_State :: struct {
	playing: bool,
	looping: bool,
	position: f64,
	tempo_bpm: f64,
	bar: i64,
	loop_start: f64,
	loop_end: f64,
	numerator: i32,
	denominator: i32,
}
```

The transport, as a surface sees it.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `playing` |  |
| `looping` |  |
| `position` | beats, on the surface's timeline |
| `tempo_bpm` |  |
| `bar` | 0-based, on the clock's bar grid |
| `loop_start` |  |
| `loop_end` |  |
| `numerator` |  |
| `denominator` |  |

### Control_Kind

```odin
Control_Kind :: enum u32 {
	Continuous,
	Toggle,
	Trigger,
	Stepped,
}
```

What a control is.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `Continuous` | a knob or fader: min..max |
| `Toggle` | on (max) or off (min): mute, solo, arm |
| `Trigger` | fires when set to max: launch a clip, tap tempo |
| `Stepped` | `steps` values from min to max: a mode, a bank |

### Control_Info

```odin
Control_Info :: struct {
	id: u32,
	kind: Control_Kind,
	name: cstring,
	group: cstring,
	min: f64,
	max: f64,
	default: f64,
	steps: u32,
}
```

A control the app publishes: anything a surface may move. Names belong
to the host.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `id` | the app's, stable while published |
| `kind` |  |
| `name` | "Volume" |
| `group` | where it belongs, "Track 1", or "" |
| `min` |  |
| `max` |  |
| `default` |  |
| `steps` | Stepped: how many values |

### Host

```odin
Host :: struct {
	abi_version: u32,
	data: rawptr,
	send_midi: proc "cdecl"(h: ^Host, port: u32, bytes: [^]u8, size: u32) -> bool,
	play: proc "cdecl"(h: ^Host),
	stop: proc "cdecl"(h: ^Host),
	locate: proc "cdecl"(h: ^Host, beats: f64),
	set_loop: proc "cdecl"(h: ^Host, on: bool, start: f64, end: f64),
	set_tempo: proc "cdecl"(h: ^Host, bpm: f64),
	get_transport: proc "cdecl"(h: ^Host, out: ^Transport_State),
	control_count: proc "cdecl"(h: ^Host) -> u32,
	control_info: proc "cdecl"(h: ^Host, index: u32, out: ^Control_Info) -> bool,
	control_get: proc "cdecl"(h: ^Host, id: u32, out: ^f64) -> bool,
	control_set: proc "cdecl"(h: ^Host, id: u32, value: f64) -> bool,
	control_touch: proc "cdecl"(h: ^Host, id: u32, touched: bool) -> bool,
	node_find: proc "cdecl"(h: ^Host, name: cstring) -> u64,
	param_set: proc "cdecl"(h: ^Host, node: u64, param: u32, value: f64) -> bool,
	log: proc "cdecl"(h: ^Host, level: i32, message: cstring),
}
```

What a surface can do. Every function is for the control thread, during
the surface's callbacks.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `abi_version` |  |
| `data` | the host's own |
| `send_midi` | MIDI to the controller (a short message, or SysEx F0 … F7). |
| `play` | The transport (the manager's timeline). |
| `stop` |  |
| `locate` |  |
| `set_loop` |  |
| `set_tempo` |  |
| `get_transport` |  |
| `control_count` | The app's controls. |
| `control_info` |  |
| `control_get` |  |
| `control_set` |  |
| `control_touch` | a gesture starts or ends (for automation touch) |
| `node_find` | Graph nodes the app names, and their parameters. 0 = no such node |
| `param_set` |  |
| `log` |  |

### Manager_Settings

```odin
Manager_Settings :: struct {
	clock: ^transport.Clock,
	timeline: core.Timeline_Id,
	graph: ^graph.Graph,
	midi_out: proc(user: rawptr, port: int, bytes: []u8) -> bool,
	on_set: proc(user: rawptr, id: u32, value: f64),
	on_touch: proc(user: rawptr, id: u32, touched: bool),
	log: proc(user: rawptr, level: i32, message: string),
	user: rawptr,
	midi: midi.Input_Config,
}
```

Settings for `manager_create`.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `clock` | the transport surfaces drive and see |
| `timeline` | which timeline (the song); zero = no transport |
| `graph` | for `param_set` on named nodes; nil = none |
| `midi_out` | MIDI to a controller: `port` is the surface's `Ports.midi_out`. |
| `on_set` | A surface moved a control: apply it (then report it with `control_changed`). |
| `on_touch` | A surface started or ended a gesture on a control. |
| `log` |  |
| `user` |  |
| `midi` | the controllers' MIDI input; zero = defaults |

### Manager

```odin
Manager :: struct {...}
```

Hosts control-surface scripts. Control thread only. Fields are internal.

### Library

```odin
Library :: struct {
	path: string,
	surfaces: []^Descriptor,
	lib: dynlib.Library,
	refs: int,
}
```

A loaded script library and the surfaces it offers. Fields other than
`path` and `surfaces` are internal.

### Ports

```odin
Ports :: struct {
	midi_in: u8,
	midi_out: int,
}
```

Which MIDI ports a surface uses: the port index the controller's input
was opened with (on the driver whose `input` is `manager_midi_input`),
and the app's number for its output (given back to `midi_out`).

### Instance

```odin
Instance :: struct {...}
```

A running surface. From `surface_start`; stop with `surface_stop`.
Fields are internal.

## Procedures

### manager_create

```odin
manager_create :: proc(settings: Manager_Settings, allocator: mem.Allocator = context.allocator) -> (m: ^Manager, err: core.Error)
```

Control thread. Makes a manager. Free with `manager_destroy`.

### manager_destroy

```odin
manager_destroy :: proc(m: ^Manager)
```

Control thread. Stops every surface, closes the libraries, frees the manager.

### manager_midi_input

```odin
manager_midi_input :: proc(m: ^Manager) -> ^midi.Midi_Input
```

The input to give a MIDI driver for the controllers' ports (set it as
the driver's `input` before opening them). Use a driver of its own, so
controller MIDI stays out of the audio thread's input.

### library_open

```odin
library_open :: proc(m: ^Manager, path: string) -> (l: ^Library, err: core.Error)
```

Control thread. Loads a script library (or returns the one already
loaded from `path`). `.Device_Error` if it won't load, doesn't export
`fire_surface_entry`, or has another ABI version.

### library_close

```odin
library_close :: proc(m: ^Manager, l: ^Library)
```

Control thread. Drops a reference; the last, with no surface running
from it, unloads it.

### port_matches

```odin
port_matches :: proc(d: ^Descriptor, port_name: string, input: bool) -> bool
```

Whether `port_name` matches one of a descriptor's hints (`input_hints`
for an input, else `output_hints`): for finding a controller's ports.

### surface_start

```odin
surface_start :: proc(m: ^Manager, lib: ^Library, index: int, ports: Ports) -> (s: ^Instance, err: core.Error)
```

Control thread. Starts surface `index` of `lib` on `ports`. The library
stays loaded while it runs. `.Device_Error` if the script fails to start.

### surface_stop

```odin
surface_stop :: proc(m: ^Manager, s: ^Instance)
```

Control thread. Stops a surface (ending any gestures it was making).

### control_publish

```odin
control_publish :: proc(m: ^Manager, info: Control_Info, value: f64)
```

Control thread. Publishes a control surfaces may move (or updates its
description), at `value`. Surfaces are told the set changed.

### control_remove

```odin
control_remove :: proc(m: ^Manager, id: u32)
```

Control thread. Withdraws a control.

### control_changed

```odin
control_changed :: proc(m: ^Manager, id: u32, value: f64)
```

Control thread. A control's value changed in the app (the mouse moved
it, automation played): surfaces are told at the next update, to move
motorized faders and light buttons.

### node_publish

```odin
node_publish :: proc(m: ^Manager, name: string, id: graph.Node_Id)
```

Control thread. Names a graph node so surfaces can set its parameters
(`node_find`, `param_set`). A name already used is moved to `id`.

### manager_update

```odin
manager_update :: proc(m: ^Manager)
```

Control thread. Delivers what happened since the last call: controller
MIDI, control changes, and transport changes, then each surface's idle.
Call it often (every UI frame).
